scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && npm run build:widget
scripts.build:widget: npm --prefix packages/widget run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/widget run build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const zlib=require('node:zlib');const root='dist/packages/widget';const files=[];const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):files.push(path.join(d,e.name)));walk(root);const size=files.filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')||f.endsWith('.css')||f.endsWith('.html')).reduce((n,f)=>n+zlib.gzipSync(fs.readFileSync(f)).length,0);if(size>50*1024){console.error('Widget package exceeds 50KB gzipped: '+size+' bytes');process.exit(1)}console.log('Widget package: '+size+' bytes gzipped (50KB maximum)')"
